llm_response.reason: The website showcases classic investment scam characteristics: promises of incredibly high and guaranteed returns (40%-80% ROI), vague and unverifiable company information, heavy use of psychological manipulation to entice deposits ('your funds are at work', 'building a better trading future'), strong emphasis on crypto-only payment methods (which are hard to trace and reverse), instant withdrawal promises, unverifiable testimonials, and lack of legitimate regulatory or contact details. These features closely fit the known patterns of investment scams.
